description: Hash evidence carries an uppercase SHA-256 hex digest, which is non-conformant per docs/spec-evidence.md §4.1.1 (wire representation is exactly ^[a-f0-9]{64}$). Under v0.9.0a2 the JSON Schema regex in sdk-python/pic_standard/schemas/proposal_schema.json was tightened from ^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$ to ^[a-f0-9]{64}$, so the proposal is rejected at pipeline step 2 (JSON Schema validation) with PIC_SCHEMA_INVALID BEFORE evidence verification runs. The underlying hex denotes a real digest (sha256 of conformance/artifacts/invoice_001.txt uppercased), so this is a pure wire-representation failure, not a hash mismatch.
source: HERMETICUM Phase 1 SHA hex-casing finding, remediated in v0.9.0a2. Schema regex tightened to ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ per docs/spec-evidence.md §4.1.1; rejection surfaces at pipeline step 2 (JSON Schema validation) with PIC_SCHEMA_INVALID. See docs/independent-reviews/hermeticum-v0.8.3.md.
